data.desc: 1-800-FLOWERS.COM, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLWS) is a leading gifting company focused on inspiring customers to give more, connect more, and build more meaningful relationships. The Company offers a broad selection of flowers, gifts, and gourmet foods to help customers celebrate life's special moments. The Company's family of brands is led by 1-800-Flowers.com and Harry & David, and includes other well-recognized gifting brands such as Cheryl's Cookies, Shari's Berries, and Moose Munch. Through its e-commerce platform and Celebrations Passport loyalty program, the Company strives to make gifting easier and more convenient for customers. The Company also operates BloomNet, a provider of products and services to the floral industry, as well as wholesale businesses Napco and DesignPac.
